feeds.title: The Jazz Guitar Blog
feeds.description: Free jazz guitar lessons that will inspire you. Learn how to play jazz from the world's biggest jazz guitar website and improve your playing instantly. JGO is an active jazz guitar community and the place to be for free jazz guitar lessons.

feeds.title: Jazz Guitar Lessons Blog
feeds.description: My name is Marc and I help guitarists progress faster using my no-nonsense lessons and foundational pillars. I've been doing this online since 2009.

feeds.title: Jens Larsen Blog
feeds.description: Jens Larsen is a jazz guitarist, composer and arranger in the groups Træben, Yvonne Smeets Group, Jazz4kids and Wijnen, Winter & Larsen. Follow his jazz guitar lessons and tips in the blog. This blog is here to give you precise and practical Jazz guitar and Music Theory lessons. To show you how things work, and also how you use them in your own playing because what is great about learning Jazz is that you become able to play Jazz and make music.

feeds.title: Jazz Guitar Today
feeds.description: The online magazine and social media community for jazz guitar professionals and enthusiasts. Our goal is to bring you the best information, tips, lessons, interviews and product reviews from the world of jazz guitar. Through our ever-growing network of industry performing professionals, educators and passionate jazz guitar enthusiasts, Jazz Guitar Today will always strive to provide readers with their daily 'jazz guitar' fix.

feeds.title: Jazz guitar Licks Blog
feeds.description: As the name states, this is a place that publishes an abundance of great lessons, videos, licks, ebooks and offers all kinds of accompanying media. Jazz Guitar Licks is definitely one of the better sources of Jazz guitar knowledge online.

feeds.title: Reynold D. Philipsek Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about jazz, guitar compositions and more in this blog. Reynold D. Philipsek has been a professional musician since he was fourteen years old. He has appeared on nearly fifty recordings either under his own name or in support of other artists.

feeds.title: Jazz Guitar Life
feeds.description: I wanted to create a site that would be a resource for those younger guys and gals who are thinking about getting into jazz guitar as a profession and don't know what to expect. Lyle Robinson is the owner/creator/publisher and editor of Jazz Guitar Life, an online magazine dedicated to the Jazz Guitar and its community of fine players worldwide.

feeds.title: Jazz guitar with Andy Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Jazz guitar with Andy blog. Here you find free resources for learning jazz guitar. Andy is a jazz guitarist and educator based in the South-West of England. An experienced teacher and performer, he specialises in jazz and swing music of the 1930s and 40s.

feeds.title: Jazz Guitar Society Blog
feeds.description: We created JazzGuitarSociety.com to be a community for guitarists to share knowledge, thoughts, and inspirations, as well as find answers to questions and pathways to advancement. In addition to things like transcriptions, chord melody arrangements, soloing, comping concepts, and just really cool licks, JazzGuitarSociety.com provides high-quality study materials from an ever-increasing collection of some of the best player/educators on the instrument.

feeds.title: Robert Conti Blog
feeds.description: The Conti learning platform provides you with immediately applicable palettes of harmonic tools that quickly pave the path to impressive short term results. Robert Conti learning resources have produced tangible results for aspiring jazz guitarists since 1966.

feeds.title: Fret Dojo Blog
feeds.description: Introducing Greg O'Rourke, a pro jazz guitarist based in Australia. His website is dedicated to providing essential concepts and techniques to aspiring jazz guitarists, allowing them to approach their craft with confidence. The goal is to offer step-by-step jazz guitar lessons that provide shortcuts to mastering key skills needed to become an exceptional jazz musician, even for those with limited time.
